question: Why can Arjuna proclaim Krishna's wondrous deeds?
premises: Nothing wondrous would be unbearable for Krishna
Krishna is doer of all, therefore all this is Krishna
inference: Arjuna's proclamation rests on Krishna's sole agency over all things
uncertainties: fused bhavedasahyaṃ may be optative or potential
plain_english: What wondrous thing of yours would be unbearable, or what could be possible from another? I will proclaim, since you are doer of all, O vibhu; therefore all this is you alone.
